info.name: ClinicalHarmony · Phase 6 — patient-index-service (PMI)
info.description: Patient Master Index, minimal walkthrough (8 requests): run matching, review the queue, reject the twin, accept the day/month-swapped birth date, view the master, undo the merge, run again. Every Gold change is applied by fhir-compliance-service's GoldWriter, which the PMI calls with its own Keycloak client. Prereqs: `docker-compose up -d`, migrations 20 + 21 applied, and Silver built into Gold (POST http://localhost:8084/api/fhir/build — only needed after a `down -v`). Run 1 → 8 in order: 1 stores {{access_token}}, 3 stores the review-item ids 5–7 use. The review items can only be decided once; auth/error cases are covered by scripts/smoke-test.sh section 15.

request.description: Same client as the Phase 5b collections (clinicalharmony-app). Stores {{access_token}}, which every request below inherits. pipeline.write is needed for every POST /api/pmi/** (they change Gold through GoldWriter); any valid token can GET. Tokens live 5 minutes — re-run 1 on a 401.

Picks up every PROVISIONAL master, blocks (DOB · Double-Metaphone surname + birth year · phone), scores pairs, then through GoldWriter: auto-merges ≥ 0.85 (or deterministic) into the oldest master, queues 0.60–0.85 for review, confirms the rest MATCHED. Expect on a fresh seed: run.autoMerges 3 (PMI-0001 → SEED-0001 deterministic; 'Jim' Wilson PMI-0002 0.9118 and same-MRN PMI-0006 → SEED-0002), queuedForReview 2, confirmedSingletons ≥ 2. On a re-run everything is 0 — decisions are durable. Add header X-Correlation-Id to see the same id in both services' logs.

Expect: the seed's two review items, both against Maria Garcia's master (masterAId): the day/month-swapped DOB (PMI-0003, score 0.6471) and the opposite-sex twin Mario (PMI-0004, 0.7143 — breakdown shows gender DISAGREE −4, which is what kept him out of auto-merge). The test script stores their ids for the next requests. ?status=ALL shows decided ones too.

exec: pm.test('both seed review items present', () => { pm.expect(swap).to.be.ok; pm.expect(twin).to.be.ok; });

request.description: Expect: master MATCHED, matchConfidenceScore 1.0000, sources SEED-0001 + PMI-0001 (two feeds, one person), fhirResources linked to it (her FHIR Patients, Conditions, …, and the CMS-0057 Coverage), merges [PMI-0001's master absorbed, DETERMINISTIC], pendingCandidates = the two review items.

item.name: 5. Reject the twin (not the same person)

request.description: Expect: 200, candidate REJECTED; the pair goes into pmi.match_exclusions (no run proposes it again), and Mario's master — PROVISIONAL with nothing else pending — is confirmed MATCHED via GoldWriter (confirmedMasterIds). Re-sending → 409.

Expect: 200, candidate ACCEPTED with mergeId; GoldWriter merged PMI-0003's master into Maria's (MANUAL, score 0.6471, decided_by 'reviewer:dana via patient-index-service'). Her FHIR Patient follows her to the surviving master. The test stores merge_id.

Expect: 200, exclusionsAdded 2 (PMI-0003 vs each of Maria's remaining records). GoldWriter moved her xref row and FHIR resources back to her own master, now MATCHED + active; the merge row keeps unmerged_at/by/reason. A reason is required (400 without). Re-sending → 409.

item.name: 8. Run matching again — human decisions stick

request.description: Expect: autoMerges 0, queuedForReview 0 — the rejected twin and the unmerged pair are excluded.
